chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhassin ibn Ahmad, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Isma'il al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

In the case of a husband and two parents, he said: 'For the husband is half, and for the mother is one-third, and for the father is what remains.' And he said in the case of a wife and two parents: 'For the wife is one-quarter, and for the mother is one-third, and what remains is for the father.'
ai.seo_question: What are the inheritance shares for parents and spouses according to Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific shares of parents and spouses, highlighting the mother's distinct one-third share which remains constant regardless of whether the deceased is male or female, while the father acts as the residuary heir (asabah). This ruling is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for resolving the distribution of the estate after the fixed portions (fara'id) are allocated, ensuring the parents' rights are preserved alongside the spouse's. The hadith underscores the principle that the mother's share is not reduced by the presence of the father, a point of scholarly emphasis in the tahdhib tradition.
